p1: At 2 a.m., my doorbell camera showed my mum. She lives four hours away.
Every Sunday she calls me, and always hangs up the same way.
On the camera, she was in her dressing gown. Smiling. Not blinking.
It's me, love. Let me in.
My hand was on the lock when my phone buzzed. A text from Mum.
Can't sleep, love. Talk on Sunday?
I said... you're not my mum.
If you won't open the door for her... let's see if she'll open it for you.
Then it walked off. Toward the highway.
Someone's at my door, love. It sounds just like you.
She's not answering. Lock the door, Mum.
I'm driving there now. Follow for what I find.
